column1: ## Round-4 SECOND captures (round4/variants/, frozen in variants-SHA256SUMS) through `provost --llm` with the
## templates stored from the FIRST capture (llm-templates-f2 over llm-templates), 2026-10-27. Rated once, blind
## (raters saw only the variant and the output), on CRITERIA.md. first = the first capture's rating (ratings-llm-templates-f2.tsv).

column8: note

key-value: NOTE/package-list lines land as key/value, but the 14 Inst/Conf records (action, package, version, release, arch) are whole lines stuffed in the key column with empty values; nothing lost, main table unstructured

indented-hierarchy collapses 7 counterexample warnings into one 27-column row with deduped keys (calc.y_N, Example_N, derivation paths); only 5 of 9 warning lines and a fraction of derivation steps survive, steps from different conflicts merged under shared names

template splits conflicts/grammar/terminals/nonterminals/items/actions into six well-named tables; every rule, symbol, item, lookahead and action (bracketed reduces as chosen=no) present for the whole input

text-lines: every line kept as one-column row, nothing lost, but each test failure (source excerpt, matcher, expected/received, location, (fail) name+time) is split across ~10 rows and the pass/skip/fail summary counts are unstructured

environment kv (section/parent/key/value) and Gemfile/Gemfile.lock lines all present; but Bundler settings split each setting over two rows with the 'Set via BUNDLE_X: value' text left in the key column and value empty

AST nodes one row each with depth/parent/kind/address/range/location/detail; but the second FunctionDecl (with 'prev 0x...') leaves range/location empty and dumps them into detail, and the ForStmt's <<<NULL>>> child line is dropped

timers table (section, name, user/system/user+system/wall time and %) plus per-section totals table with Total Execution Time/wall clock; all 7 sections and every timer present (only the always-100% total percentages omitted)

records/fields (offsets, bitfield offsets, nesting)/decls (LLVMType)/decl_fields/bitfields all well-structured; the bitfield FieldDecls' ConstantExpr/IntegerLiteral child nodes are reduced to a bitwidth and kind list, losing their addresses, ranges and types

calls (file, line, command, args) and -- messages cleanly tabled; but the CMakeLists.txt(1) cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22) call (line with appended prose) is dropped, as is the 'CMake Warning at CMakeLists.txt:16' diagnostic and its text

version/built, options (short/long/description) and commands (command/aliases/description) all correct; the Usage line 'command [options] [arguments]' is dropped and the 'test' namespace group header is lost (test:* rows keep their prefix)
all 98 -W flags one row each with depth and parent preserving the tree; 3-entry colour legend kept as a kv row; nothing lost
text-lines fallback: all 100 lines kept verbatim but nothing structured - keyword/glob, colour code and trailing comment merged in one column A, comment lines mixed in with entries
summary kv (device, blocksize, blocks, free, extent stats) as one wide row; histogram 7 rows with range split into from/to and real Free_extents/Free_Blocks/Percent columns; nothing lost
pattern header (36 elts, size 48), all 36 properties with value/type/binding, and 45 charset pages with their bitmaps in a separate table; nothing lost
Source metadata, 4 function summaries, 37 source lines with count/function, 18 branch and 4 call records tied to line and function; nothing lost
7 function and 3 file blocks plus the grand total as kind/name/metric/percent/of rows (No branches kept), Creating .gcov lines as a file-to-gcov table; nothing lost
8 top-level fields and all 41 namespace::attribute pairs as two wide rows with real names (:: mapped to _); nothing lost
WORK var, 19 commands with cwd/env/command/args/# internal note, and 70 importcfg directives keyed by file incl. the modinfo line; only EOF/# import config decoration dropped

package+doc, 2 types, 18 funcs with receiver/params/result/doc all right, but the Value field's doc comment sits on its own unnamed row apart from the Value field row (record split); New() loses its tie to type List
read as yaml into ONE wide row with 107 linter-name columns: the Enabled vs Disabled section split (the point of the output) is gone, wsl [deprecated] dropped, records transposed to columns

all 12 issues one row each with file/line/col/message/linter/source; '12 issues' total and per-linter counts kept as summary + issues_by_linter; only caret pointer lines (decoration, col already captured) dropped

flat profile (6 rows, real headers), call-graph primary entries (7), caller/callee lines incl <spontaneous> (13) tied to their entry, function index (6), and sample interval/granularity/total seconds all kept correctly structured
source file, terminal name/aliases/description, and all 101 capabilities as terminal/capability/type/value rows (boolean/numeric/string) with values intact incl. escape sequences

all 90 lines' data kept in 7 well-structured datasets (pauses, phases, heap regions, metaspace, cpu, log, init); but the 16 gc,init lines are collapsed into one wide row that drops their per-line uptimes (0.004s/0.006s) and level

key-value fallback (template declined): 'Compiled from', class declaration and the LOG field declaration dropped; members become keys with empty values, detached from their descriptor rows; each method's bytecode mashed into one Code value; LocalVariableTable header and rows glued into one string (or split with header as a row)

pid/loaders/classes summary, usage (3 spaces x all metrics), virtual space, 45 chunk-freelist rows per space ((none)=0) with totals, waste, chunk header pool, internal statistics and settings all present under real names

6 GCHeapMemoryPoolUsage and 6 ThreadStart events one row each with real field names (thread ids split out, N/A parent kept), 14 stack frames linked by event id with frame/line; only the '...' truncation marker in one stack trace not kept
recording header (Version/Chunks/Start/Duration) as one row and all 46 event types with real Event_Type/Count/Size_(bytes) columns; only the rule line dropped

process (pid, Server compiler, JVM version, thread-local allocation), collector + threads, 12 heap-config rows with bytes and MB split, 4 heap-usage spaces with generation and every metric; only attach/wait chatter dropped
all 19 plugins one row each with option/argument/description (wrapped description joined), pattern-list note and its 4 forms kept; only the 'List of available plugins:' title dropped

threads/vm_threads/monitors/jni_refs well named and complete, but frames, monitors and thread states are split into separate tables with no thread key (which stack belongs to which thread is lost); dump timestamp, JVM version line, SMR thread-list and 'No compile task' lines dropped
both sections (18 CPUs, 46 features) filed as named cpu/feature + description tables, every entry intact; only the static two-line usage footer dropped

every command and its output kept in 10 well-named tables keyed by step/command (executable, breakpoint, process events, thread, frames, source listing, variables, struct fields, images); only the caret column marker dropped
file, compile-unit header (all fields named), DIE tree with offset/depth/parent/tag/name, and all 106 attributes as die/tag/attribute/value; NULL terminators implied by the depth/parent structure

summary kv, both legends, Instruction Info and both resource-pressure tables filed with real column names (bracket indices resolved to resource names), values in the right columns; '-' rendered as empty
file kv, ElfHeader (Ident nested as dotted names) and all 7 (truncated) Sections with named fields and flag lists intact; only per-flag bit constants like (0x2) dropped

aligned-columns took 'ninja: Entering directory `build'' as the header, so build steps, the warning and the metrics table sit under bogus columns (ninja:/Entering/directory) with words split and avg/total merged; the stats table's real header is a data row
all 19 GC events in one well-named table (pid, time, type, before/after heap, durations, mu, reason, Mark-Compact detail); the two interleaved program lines 'kept 1840' / 'kept 3712' dropped
all 59 ops kept with seq/class/op/flags/next in stable columns plus the syntax-check line, but the indentation depth that encodes the op tree's parent/child nesting is lost
text-lines fallback: every line kept as one whole-line column A, nothing dropped, but the per-method ops/sec and usecs/op tables are not split into columns and rows are not tied to their test section

All 12 histogram rows under real columns (us, %_of_total, count); both header facts (2 seconds, 21.87 ns per loop) kept as summary kv; only the 'Histogram of timing durations:' title and '<' glyph dropped

Full reflection dump normalised into class/sections/methods/parameters/members: every constant+value, all 7 properties, 11 methods with source/modifiers/param count/return kind+type, all 8 parameters with required/optional, type and default; nothing lost

7 diagnostics cleanly split into level/message/line/file and the '4 pod syntax errors' summary kept, but the 8th diagnostic (WARNING multiple occurrences (2) of link target 'OPTIONS' at line -) is dropped
All 80 headerless settings rows filed with accurate pg names (name, context, category, vartype, default, min, max, short_desc, long_desc); empty fields stay aligned, long descriptions intact
All 32 values as section/key/value, including the two-per-line pairs and the multi-value minor/major and user/system/guest/blkio rows expanded into named keys; section names kept

Module name/summary/reference URL/file, all 4 paragraphs (MODULE REFERENCE, DESCRIPTION), 4 functions with args+doc one per row, DATA __all__ all kept; only the inline pattern mini-table inside fnmatch's doc is flattened into its doc text
Version and copyright kept; all 17 formatters one per row with name, aliases, description and (filenames) split out into its own column; nothing lost

Session header+final counts, progress line, both failures (file/line/exception/error/source), captured stdout+log, and all 11 short-summary results kept; lost: the warnings summary section (test_legacy DeprecationWarning at pricing.py:18 and its message), the locals line (net=Decimal('10'), country='dk') and the intermediate frame location test_pricing.py:29
All 57 AST nodes as an id/parent/depth/field/node tree with scalar attrs (incl. empty lists like orelse=[], type_ignores=[]) attached; structure and every value preserved

All 6 frames (file/line/function/code) and chain links (direct cause / during handling) right, and tracebacks 1 and 3 correct, but traceback 2's exception is misfiled: exception='source', message='/etc/orders/worker.json' while 'SettingsError: worker.timeout_s missing or invalid' is lost (value under the wrong name)
all 64 opcode lines as rows (pos/code/opcode/arg, MARK-indent stripped, args intact incl. UTF-8 strings) plus the 'highest protocol = 4' footer as a summary row; nothing lost
all 85 lines: 17 classes + 68 methods, one row each with kind/name/parent/depth/bases/lineno; nesting kept as parent column; nothing lost
8 warnings, one row each with file/line/category/message/source line; the two 'Enable tracemalloc' follow-up lines attached as note to their ResourceWarning/RuntimeWarning rows; nothing lost
8 entries under real headers File_Name/Modified/Size; names with spaces and the over-long path that breaks column alignment parsed correctly; mojibake kept verbatim as in input
all sections survive: 16 progress rows (pct/type/key/size), 5 biggest-per-type rows, sampled 607, key length 9380/avg 15.45, 6 per-type summary rows; only the banner comment and rule lines dropped

9 samples under real headers keys/mem/clients/blocked/requests/connections plus child (from the '- child -' group header) holding SAVE; group banner names data/load not carried, requests delta kept with count as in input

3 linked tables: 6 iseqs (name/file/line/range + local-table size/argc/opts/...), 10 locals, all 70 instructions with operands/line/events; but the <Opt=0> flag on add's qty local is dropped (kind empty)
settings row carries all 21 speed/rows/columns/line/control-char values; all 53 mode flags as mode/value rows (on/off, cs8/nl0/... under their field names); nothing lost
all 44 syscalls in 8 groups, one row each with group and its '#' description; nothing lost

7 status/file/other_file rows and the '7 overridden' summary are right, but the whole unified diff of ssh.service (headers, hunk, -/+ ExecStart change, ~13 of the ~21 content lines) is dropped despite coverage 100%

58 option/value rows correct incl. quoted strings and indexed array options, but the first 3 lines (@continuum-restore on, @plugin tmux-plugins/tmux-resurrect, @resurrect-capture-pane-contents on) are dropped

threads, 3 races (access/size/address/locks/conflict/symbol), per-frame stacks, program output and ERROR SUMMARY all right; but the 'Lock at 0x10C060 was first observed' record (stats_lock symbol) is lost and its 2 frames are mis-filed as frames 7-8 of thread #2's creation stack; preamble (Command: ./race, Valgrind-3.19.0) dropped

all 25 events with clock/self+sourced/self/event in stable columns; but the two-value lines' 'elapsed' time (the input's own header) is filed under 'self' rather than its own name, and the 'times in msec' unit line is dropped
document properties (version/encoding/URL/standalone) as kv row, all 40 nodes with id/parent/depth/type/name/compact/content (whitespace content kept), namespace declaration in its own table
5 local headers (offset/signature) plus all 100 field lines with record, parent extra block, offset, field name, hex value and decoded text; [Bits 1-2] sub-field and both PAYLOAD lines kept
all 15 entries under the input's real headers IDENTIFIER/TIMESTAMP/T/C/RESOURCE_NAME/DESCRIPTION, multi-word descriptions intact

24 of 25 attributes correct as attribute/value/description/user_settable (empty location value kept), but unique_id's value 3321...IBMfcp is merged into the description column and its value cell is empty
all 45 apcaccess keys as one wide record with real names (END APC -> END_APC), values with units intact and trailing padding trimmed
all 16 entries under real headers Vlan/Mac_Address/Type/Ports plus the 'Total Mac Addresses for this criterion: 16' summary; only prompt/title/rule decoration dropped
CPU utilization line as five_seconds/one_minute/five_minutes (38%/14% kept) and all 18 processes under real headers, multi-word process names intact; only the prompt lines dropped

pool + 5 members' Status kv (real field names, Member key) and every Traffic counter per pool/member with ServerSide/General headers all present and correctly placed; only the tmsh prompt echo and rules dropped
all 12 columns (type, nullability, default, CHECK and COLLATE continuations folded into their column), 5 constraints and 4 triggers land in three keyed tables with correct values; nothing lost

runner header, 8 sections with start/end/duration, and every log line keyed by section are present, but the 3 step_script commands sit in a separate table so which output belongs to which command (command/output interleaving) is lost
both controllers, drive cages, ports, arrays, logical drives, all 18 physical drives (incl. Unassigned + spare role) and the SEP land in keyed tables with correct names and values; nothing lost

9 disks with real headers and continuation device files folded in, but disk 0's 8 device files are mangled: two /dev/dsk paths filed under Raw_device_file and all four /dev/rdsk paths dropped (values under the wrong column name)
schedd header (host, address, timestamp), all 7 batch rows under the real headers, and both totals lines broken into named counts; nothing lost
all 20 interfaces with real headers and correct values, but the indentation-encoded Eth-Trunk membership (which ports belong to Eth-Trunk10/20) is lost and the flag legend dropped

screen title/system/date, all 11 status kv fields (auxiliary-storage ones prefixed) and the 6 pool rows under combined two-line headers are all correct; only 5250 screen chrome (prompt, F-keys, Bottom) dropped

server banner, 8 dbspaces and 11 chunks are correct, but the sbspace Metadata line is split into its own table with no chunk key, the two 'active/maximum' count rows don't say which section they belong to, and the pgsize NOTE is dropped

model, apps, offers and units are right, but the 5 lxd container machine rows are filed into the units table under unit headers (Workload=started, Agent=address, Machine=inst id, Public_address=base, Message='zone1  Container started'); machines table holds only the 3 hosts

all 38 interface/address rows under real headers (Interface/Admin/Link/Proto/Local/Remote); continuation addresses carry their logical interface; --> targets (ae0.0, 0/0, ::/0) land in Remote; only prompt/{master:0} decoration dropped
all 22 klog events one row each with level/timestamp/pid/source/message; the multi-line err=<...> event folded into one record; nothing lost
all three tables (instance groups, node status, validation errors) with real headers and every row, plus summary row keeping cluster context, Validation Failed and the Error line

all 35 rows and 6 values correct under sensible names (input has no header), but the name indentation that encodes the taxonomy tree depth is stripped, so the hierarchy (e.g. Viruses under root vs Bacteria under cellular organisms) is lost

all 37 keys as one wide record with real names (spaces to underscores) and full values; only the 'This disk is an APFS Volume. APFS Information:' section heading dropped, which is redundant with File System Personality

all 22 nodes with name/class/id/registered/matched/active/busy/retain correct (incl. !registered and ç), but the +-o tree nesting is dropped: no depth or parent column, so which device hangs off which hub/controller is lost

all 42 attributes as one record with real key names and values; multi-line lists joined with ';', (null) and empty values kept; only the leading underscore of _kMDItemDisplayNameWithExtensions normalised away

every section survives: device types, runtimes (version/build/id split), devices with runtime group/udid/state/unavailability reason, and device pairs plus their Watch/Phone members linked by pair udid

all 12 interfaces one row each with index, flags, ;;; comments and every key=value under its own name (continuation lines merged), plus the Flags legend as its own dataset; minor: index column is named '#', duplicating the generated row-id header

all 12 sessions under real headers with values in the right columns (empty ProgramName, BlkBy 62, multi-word Command/ProgramName intact); duplicate SPID header disambiguated as SPID2; dash rule dropped
all 10 two-line sessions joined into one row each; Src/Dst addr, port, zone, proto and translated IP/port split into named columns, Vsys kept; only the prompt and rule lines dropped

metrics row correct under all 36 real column names (empty SAMPLE/LIBRARY/READ_GROUP kept); the header lost: CollectAlignmentSummaryMetrics command line with options, 'Started on' time and the METRICS CLASS

7 requests correctly rolled up (method, path, client, controller#action, format, params, status, timings, error + backtrace); but the second 'Rendered layout' line went to events rather than renders, and the timestamps of the Processing/Completed/FATAL lines and the FATAL level are dropped
all 9 hosts (global included) under the 11 real headers, '-' placeholders kept, values aligned; only the rule line dropped

text-lines fallback: three tables (db info, device fragments, segments) filed as raw lines in one column 'A', header and rule lines as data rows; nothing structured, no real column names (text all present)

all 43 lines kept with time/severity/step split; 13 test service messages parsed into named columns, but the postcode test (escaped quotes), testStdOut, buildStatisticValue and publishArtifacts messages left unparsed in the log table, so one record type is split across two tables
held: low-coverage kv-pairs queued in 'unsorted', template did not fit; nothing wrong filed but none of the 9 clients (clid, cid, db id, nickname, type) or the error id/msg extracted

session header (BTEQ version, start, PID, release/version, semantics, charset, RC), 4 statements with results/rows/cols/elapsed, and all 9 result rows under real headers with '?' nulls; only rule lines dropped
4 boot entries as 4 rows with entry type and every key under its real name, multi-line displayorder joined, absent keys blank; only rule lines dropped

every section kept: RSOP header kv, computer/user settings, applied and filtered GPOs with Filtering/WMI Filter, and both security-group lists, scoped by COMPUTER/USER; only banner/copyright and rules dropped

all 7 sessions, real header names (IDLE_TIME, LOGON_TIME); '>' current-session marker kept as CURRENT column; blank SESSIONNAME for disconnected sessions left empty, not shifted; UTF-8 username intact

5 datasets cover job header (incl. both Speed lines, Ended), 7 directories, 9 files with parent dir, 3 errors, and the Dirs/Files/Bytes/Times summary with Times blanks correctly placed; but on the 3rd error 'ERROR: RETRY LIMIT EXCEEDED.' is merged into the message column while its retry column is empty (part not in a stable column)

4 tasks, one row each with all 28 key-value fields under their real names plus the Folder heading carried down (\Fabrikam vs \Fabrikam\Wartung); empty Power Management kept empty; values with colons, commas and paths intact

all 21 processes, 9 real column names; multi-word image names, statuses ('Not Responding'), user names and window titles (incl. non-ASCII) kept whole under the right columns; '=' rule line dropped as decoration

all 25 privileges with real headers Privilege_Name/Description/State; multi-word descriptions kept whole, including the longest one; 'PRIVILEGES INFORMATION' title and rule lines dropped as decoration

10 connections with all 21 #fields names as header, values aligned (IPv6, '-', '(empty)', set values intact); meta row keeps separator/set_separator/empty_field/unset_field/path/open/close; but the #types line (per-field types) is dropped

command, 4 entries (type/name/parent/catalog), 84 entry/section/key/value attributes, the 14 entry counts + protected-suppressed count, and both IDC messages all present with real keys; but the two VOLUME blocks of the DATA component share keys with no volume index (separable only by row order), and the page-header run TIME/date (22:07:49 10/26/26) is not kept
